ingredients: 2 lb stew beef, cut into ½-inch cubes
3 cups beef broth (up to 5 for a soupier version)

items: 2 lb stew beef, cut into ½-inch cubes
3 cups beef broth (up to 5 for a soupier version)

steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Season beef with salt and pepper; brown on all sides, ~5 min. Remove and set aside.
Add onion; cook 5–6 min to soften.
Reduce heat and stir in paprika off heat for 1 min (so it doesn't burn).
Return to medium heat. Add beef, bell peppers, garlic, tomatoes, broth, bay leaves and caraway seeds. Bring to a boil, then reduce and simmer 1.5 hours.
Add potatoes and carrots (more broth as desired). Cover and simmer 30 min more, until vegetables are tender.
Adjust seasoning and serve (great over egg noodles or with crusty bread).
